art_style.mood: playful, commercial-creative energy — a design studio moment, confident and colorful

pose.facing: 3/4 toward mood board, tablet held forward

subject.scene_narrative: A young man stands at a small design studio easel stand, cradling a drawing tablet mid-sketch of an abstract, non-letter logo shape while placing a fresh color swatch chip onto a mood board of stacked palette cards — the same full-body flat vector language as the approved Q1 references. Energetic, commercial brand-building creativity.
subject.hero_prop: cork mood board on an easel stand holding a small stack of yellow, lavender, and teal color-swatch cards
supporting_props: drawing tablet with abstract teal logo mark mid-sketch
subject.environment: thin grey floor line only, two faint grey circles behind figure — no room interior

composition.layout: figure left-of-center, mood board right at chest height, balanced like 1.1.png
composition.thumbnail_test: silhouette of person + mood board readable at 160px

generation.negative_prompt: face photograph, realistic skin pores, text, watermark, logo, letter A, real brand marks, border frame, sticker card, top-down POV hands only, white background fill, photorealistic, 3d render, cropped head, extra limbs, industrial horror, guns, blood

prompt_for_image_ai: Flat vector full-body illustration, 640x640, transparent PNG background. Style MUST match KursoKo reference assets 1.1.png and 1.2.png: unDraw-inspired edu character, thin 2px dark outline #2D2D2D, flat color fills, minimal dot-eye face. Young college-age man, lean casual build, light olive skin #D9A876, short textured quiff with undercut sides, standing beside a cork mood board on an easel stand. He wears a purple #4B2C7F relaxed denim shirt with charcoal collar and yellow #FFD54F cuff stripe, rolled sleeves, black jeans, and sneakers. He cradles a dark grey drawing tablet showing a simple teal #4DB6AC abstract geometric mark mid-sketch on screen (no letters or words) while pinching a yellow swatch chip to place onto the mood board's small stack of yellow, lavender, and teal color-swatch cards. An orange-glow stylus rests near the tablet. Thin grey floor line, faint grey decorative circles only — NO opaque background, NO text, NO letter, NO border frame, NO real brand logos. Mood: playful, confident, commercially creative brand-building energy. Full head-to-feet visible.
